title: सप्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Sanjaya describes the six great mountains of Jambudvipa, Mount Meru and the Ganga falling from heaven. He pictures the earth in the form of the hare seen in the moon.
summary.kn: ಜಂಬೂದ್ವೀಪದ ಆರು ಮಹಾಪರ್ವತಗಳು, ಮೇರು ಪರ್ವತ, ಸ್ವರ್ಗದಿಂದ ಇಳಿಯುವ ಗಂಗೆ ಇವನ್ನು ಸಂಜಯನು ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಚಂದ್ರನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಮೊಲದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಭೂಮಿಯ ಆಕಾರವನ್ನು ಚಿತ್ರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: संजय जम्बूद्वीप के छह महान पर्वतों, मेरु पर्वत और स्वर्ग से उतरती गंगा का वर्णन करते हैं। वे पृथ्वी का आकार चन्द्रमा के शशक के रूप में चित्रित करते हैं।
summary.te: జంబూద్వీపంలోని ఆరు మహా పర్వతాలు, మేరు పర్వతం, స్వర్గం నుండి దిగే గంగ వర్ణిస్తాడు. చంద్రునిలోని కుందేలు ఆకారంలో భూమి రూపాన్ని చిత్రిస్తాడు.
summary.ta: ஜம்புத்வீபத்தின் ஆறு பெருமலைகள், மேரு மலை, வானிலிருந்து இறங்கும் கங்கை ஆகியவற்றைச் சஞ்சயன் விவரிக்கிறான். நிலவிலுள்ள முயலின் வடிவில் பூமியின் அமைப்பை வரைகிறான்.
summary.ml: ജംബുദ്വീപിലെ ആറ് മഹാപർവതങ്ങളെയും സ്വർഗത്തിൽനിന്ന് ഇറങ്ങുന്ന ഗംഗയെയും മേരു പർവതത്തെയും സഞ്ജയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. ചന്ദ്രനിൽ കാണുന്ന മുയലിന്റെ രൂപത്തിലുള്ള ഭൂമിയെ അദ്ദേഹം സങ്കൽപ്പിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.7; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
उक्तो द्वीपस्य संक्षेपो विस्तरं ब्रूहि संजय ।
यावद्भूम्यवकाशोऽयं दृश्यते शशलक्षणे ।
तस्य प्रमाणं प्रब्रूहि ततो वक्ष्यसि पिप्पलम् ॥

meaning.en: You have given the summary of the island; now tell me the detail, Sanjaya. Tell me the measure of this land that is seen in the hare's mark, and then you will describe the pipal tree.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्तः स राज्ञा तु संजयो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
प्रागायता महाराज षडेते रत्नपर्वताः ।
अवगाढा ह्युभयतः समुद्रौ पूर्वपश्चिमौ ॥

meaning.en: Addressed thus by the king, Sanjaya replied: "Great king, there are these six jewel mountains, stretching east to west and plunged at both ends into the eastern and western seas."

verses.text:
हिमवान्हेमकूटश्च निषधश्च नगोत्तमः ।
नीलश्च वैडूर्यमयः श्वेतश्च रजतप्रभः ।
सर्वधातुविनद्धश्च शृङ्गवान्नाम पर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: "They are the Himalaya, Hemakuta, Nishadha the best of mountains, Nila made of lapis lazuli, Shveta shining like silver, and the mountain Shringavan, bound with every mineral."

verses.text:
एते वै पर्वता राजन्सिद्धचारणसेविताः ।
तेषामन्तरविष्कम्भो योजनानि सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: "King, these mountains are frequented by Siddhas and Charanas; the width between them is thousands of yojanas."

verses.text:
तत्र पुण्या जनपदास्तानि वर्षाणि भारत ।
वसन्ति तेषु सत्त्वानि नानाजातीनि सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: "Between them lie holy lands, those regions, Bharata; beings of many kinds live in them everywhere."

verses.text:
इदं तु भारतं वर्षं ततो हैमवतं परम् ।
हेमकूटात्परं चैव हरिवर्षं प्रचक्षते ॥

meaning.en: "This is the Bharata region; beyond it is Haimavata, and beyond Hemakuta they speak of Harivarsha."

verses.text:
दक्षिणेन तु नीलस्य निषधस्योत्तरेण च ।
प्रागायतो महाराज माल्यवान्नाम पर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: "South of Nila and north of Nishadha, great king, stretches east to west a mountain named Malyavan."

verses.text:
ततः परं माल्यवतः पर्वतो गन्धमादनः ।
परिमण्डलस्तयोर्मध्ये मेरुः कनकपर्वतः ॥

meaning.en: "Beyond Malyavan is the mountain Gandhamadana, and between the two stands round Meru, the golden mountain."

verses.text:
आदित्यतरुणाभासो विधूम इव पावकः ।
योजनानां सहस्राणि षोडशाधः किल स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: "It shines like the young sun and like a smokeless fire; it is said to go sixteen thousand yojanas down."

verses.text:
उच्चैश्च चतुराशीतिर्योजनानां महीपते ।
ऊर्ध्वमन्तश्च तिर्यक्च लोकानावृत्य तिष्ठति ॥

meaning.en: "Lord of the earth, it is eighty-four thousand yojanas high, and it stands encircling the worlds above, within and across."

verses.text:
तस्य पार्श्वे त्विमे द्वीपाश्चत्वारः संस्थिताः प्रभो ।
भद्राश्वः केतुमालश्च जम्बूद्वीपश्च भारत ।
उत्तराश्चैव कुरवः कृतपुण्यप्रतिश्रयाः ॥

meaning.en: "Beside it, lord, lie these four islands: Bhadrashva, Ketumala, Jambudvipa, and the Northern Kurus, the refuge of those who have done good deeds."

verses.text:
विहगः सुमुखो यत्र सुपर्णस्यात्मजः किल ।
स वै विचिन्तयामास सौवर्णान्प्रेक्ष्य वायसान् ॥

meaning.en: "There the bird Sumukha, said to be a son of Garuda, once looked at golden crows and reflected."

verses.text:
मेरुरुत्तममध्यानामधमानां च पक्षिणाम् ।
अविशेषकरो यस्मात्तस्मादेनं त्यजाम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: "'Because Meru makes no difference between the best, the middling and the worst of birds, I leave it.'"

verses.text:
तमादित्योऽनुपर्येति सततं ज्योतिषां पतिः ।
चन्द्रमाश्च सनक्षत्रो वायुश्चैव प्रदक्षिणम् ॥

meaning.en: "The sun, lord of lights, always circles it, and the moon with the stars and the wind go around it keeping it to their right."

verses.text:
स पर्वतो महाराज दिव्यपुष्पफलान्वितः ।
भवनैरावृतः सर्वैर्जाम्बूनदमयैः शुभैः ॥

meaning.en: "Great king, that mountain bears divine flowers and fruit and is surrounded by lovely buildings made of Jambunada gold."

verses.text:
तत्र देवगणा राजन्गन्धर्वासुरराक्षसाः ।
अप्सरोगणसंयुक्ताः शैले क्रीडन्ति नित्यशः ॥

meaning.en: "There the hosts of gods, Gandharvas, Asuras and Rakshasas, with throngs of Apsarases, ever sport on the mountain."

verses.text:
तत्र ब्रह्मा च रुद्रश्च शक्रश्चापि सुरेश्वरः ।
समेत्य विविधैर्यज्ञैर्यजन्तेऽनेकदक्षिणैः ॥

meaning.en: "There Brahma, Rudra and Shakra, lord of the gods, gather and worship with many sacrifices and abundant gifts."

verses.text:
तुम्बुरुर्नारदश्चैव विश्वावसुर्हहा हुहूः ।
अभिगम्यामरश्रेष्ठाः स्तवै स्तुन्वन्ति चाभिभो ॥

meaning.en: "Tumburu, Narada, Vishvavasu, Haha and Huhu, the best of the immortals, approach and praise the Lord with hymns."

verses.text:
सप्तर्षयो महात्मानः कश्यपश्च प्रजापतिः ।
तत्र गच्छन्ति भद्रं ते सदा पर्वणि पर्वणि ॥

meaning.en: "May good fortune be yours; the great-souled Seven Sages and the Prajapati Kashyapa go there at every festival day."

verses.text:
तस्यैव मूर्धन्युशनाः काव्यो दैत्यैर्महीपते ।
तस्य हीमानि रत्नानि तस्येमे रत्नपर्वताः ॥

meaning.en: "On its very summit, lord of the earth, Ushanas Kavya lives with the Daityas; these jewels are his, and these jewel mountains."

verses.text:
तस्मात्कुबेरो भगवांश्चतुर्थं भागमश्नुते ।
ततः कलांशं वित्तस्य मनुष्येभ्यः प्रयच्छति ॥

meaning.en: "From it the blessed Kubera takes a fourth part, and from that gives a sixteenth part of the wealth to human beings."

verses.text:
पार्श्वे तस्योत्तरे दिव्यं सर्वर्तुकुसुमं शिवम् ।
कर्णिकारवनं रम्यं शिलाजालसमुद्गतम् ॥

meaning.en: "On its northern side is a lovely, auspicious, divine grove of karnikara trees, with flowers in every season, rising amid rocky masses."

verses.text:
तत्र साक्षात्पशुपतिर्दिव्यैर्भूतैः समावृतः ।
उमासहायो भगवान्रमते भूतभावनः ॥

meaning.en: "There the lord of beings, Pashupati himself, the maker of creatures, surrounded by divine spirits, delights with Uma beside him."

verses.text:
कर्णिकारमयीं मालां बिभ्रत्पादावलम्बिनीम् ।
त्रिभिर्नेत्रैः कृतोद्द्योतस्त्रिभिः सूर्यैरिवोदितैः ॥

meaning.en: "He wears a garland of karnikara flowers hanging to his feet and shines with his three eyes, like three suns risen."

verses.text:
तमुग्रतपसः सिद्धाः सुव्रताः सत्यवादिनः ।
पश्यन्ति न हि दुर्वृत्तैः शक्यो द्रष्टुं महेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: "Siddhas of fierce austerity, firm in vows and truthful, see him; Maheshvara cannot be seen by evildoers."

verses.text:
तस्य शैलस्य शिखरात्क्षीरधारा नरेश्वर ।
त्रिंशद्बाहुपरिग्राह्या भीमनिर्घातनिस्वना ॥

meaning.en: "From the peak of that mountain, lord of men, falls a stream of milk-white water that thirty men's arms could scarcely hold, with a terrible crashing sound."

verses.text:
पुण्या पुण्यतमैर्जुष्टा गङ्गा भागीरथी शुभा ।
पतत्यजस्रवेगेन ह्रदे चान्द्रमसे शुभे ।
तया ह्युत्पादितः पुण्यः स ह्रदः सागरोपमः ॥

meaning.en: "This is the holy, auspicious Ganga, Bhagirathi, frequented by the most pure, and she falls with unbroken force into a lovely lake of the moon; that lake she created is sacred and like an ocean."

verses.text:
तां धारयामास पुरा दुर्धरां पर्वतैरपि ।
शतं वर्षसहस्राणां शिरसा वै महेश्वरः ॥

meaning.en: "Long ago Maheshvara bore her on his head for a hundred thousand years, though she could not be borne even by mountains."

verses.text:
मेरोस्तु पश्चिमे पार्श्वे केतुमालो महीपते ।
जम्बूषण्डश्च तत्रैव सुमहान्नन्दनोपमः ॥

meaning.en: "On the western side of Meru, lord of the earth, lies Ketumala, and there a great grove of rose-apple trees like Nandana."

verses.text:
आयुर्दश सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तत्र भारत ।
सुवर्णवर्णाश्च नराः स्त्रियश्चाप्सरसोपमाः ॥

meaning.en: "There, Bharata, life lasts ten thousand years; the men are golden in colour and the women like Apsarases."

verses.text:
अनामया वीतशोका नित्यं मुदितमानसाः ।
जायन्ते मानवास्तत्र निष्टप्तकनकप्रभाः ॥

meaning.en: "The people born there are free of sickness and sorrow, always cheerful, shining like refined gold."

verses.text:
गन्धमादनशृङ्गेषु कुबेरः सह राक्षसैः ।
संवृतोऽप्सरसां संघैर्मोदते गुह्यकाधिपः ॥

meaning.en: "On the peaks of Gandhamadana the lord of the Guhyakas, Kubera, rejoices with Rakshasas, surrounded by throngs of Apsarases."

verses.text:
गन्धमादनपादेषु परेष्वपरगण्डिकाः ।
एकादश सहस्राणि वर्षाणां परमायुषः ॥

meaning.en: "On the further slopes of Gandhamadana lie the western valleys, where the longest life is eleven thousand years."

verses.text:
तत्र कृष्णा नरा राजंस्तेजोयुक्ता महाबलाः ।
स्त्रियश्चोत्पलपत्राभाः सर्वाः सुप्रियदर्शनाः ॥

meaning.en: "There, King, the men are dark, full of vigour and very strong, and all the women are like lotus petals and very pleasing to see."

verses.text:
नीलात्परतरं श्वेतं श्वेताद्धैरण्यकं परम् ।
वर्षमैरावतं नाम ततः शृङ्गवतः परम् ॥

meaning.en: "Beyond Nila is Shveta, beyond Shveta is Hairanyaka, the region named Airavata, and beyond that Shringavan."

verses.text:
धनुःसंस्थे महाराज द्वे वर्षे दक्षिणोत्तरे ।
इलावृतं मध्यमं तु पञ्च वर्षाणि चैव ह ॥

meaning.en: "Great king, two regions, southern and northern, are shaped like a bow; Ilavrita is in the middle, and there are five other regions."

verses.text:
उत्तरोत्तरमेतेभ्यो वर्षमुद्रिच्यते गुणैः ।
आयुष्प्रमाणमारोग्यं धर्मतः कामतोऽर्थतः ॥

meaning.en: "Each region to the north excels the one before in qualities: length of life, health, dharma, pleasure and wealth."

verses.text:
समन्वितानि भूतानि तेषु वर्षेषु भारत ।
एवमेषा महाराज पर्वतैः पृथिवी चिता ॥

meaning.en: "Bharata, beings are endowed with these in those regions. In this way, great king, the earth is marked out by mountains."

verses.text:
हेमकूटस्तु सुमहान्कैलासो नाम पर्वतः ।
यत्र वैश्रवणो राजा गुह्यकैः सह मोदते ॥

meaning.en: "The great Hemakuta is the mountain called Kailasa, where King Vaishravana rejoices with the Guhyakas."

verses.text:
अस्त्युत्तरेण कैलासं मैनाकं पर्वतं प्रति ।
हिरण्यशृङ्गः सुमहान्दिव्यो मणिमयो गिरिः ॥

meaning.en: "North of Kailasa, toward the mountain Mainaka, is the great divine mountain Hiranyashringa, made of gems."

verses.text:
तस्य पार्श्वे महद्दिव्यं शुभं काञ्चनवालुकम् ।
रम्यं बिन्दुसरो नाम यत्र राजा भगीरथः ।
दृष्ट्वा भागीरथीं गङ्गामुवास बहुलाः समाः ॥

meaning.en: "Beside it is a great, divine, auspicious, lovely lake with golden sand called Bindusara, where King Bhagiratha lived many years after beholding the Ganga Bhagirathi."

verses.text:
यूपा मणिमयास्तत्र चित्याश्चापि हिरण्मयाः ।
तत्रेष्ट्वा तु गतः सिद्धिं सहस्राक्षो महायशाः ॥

meaning.en: "There the sacrificial posts are of gems and the altars of gold; having sacrificed there, the greatly famous thousand-eyed Indra reached perfection."

verses.text:
सृष्ट्वा भूतपतिर्यत्र सर्वलोकान्सनातनः ।
उपास्यते तिग्मतेजा वृतो भूतैः समागतैः ।
नरनारायणौ ब्रह्मा मनुः स्थाणुश्च पञ्चमः ॥

meaning.en: "There the eternal Lord of beings, having created all the worlds, is worshipped, fierce in splendour and surrounded by assembled beings, with Nara and Narayana, Brahma, Manu, and Sthanu as the fifth."

verses.text:
तत्र त्रिपथगा देवी प्रथमं तु प्रतिष्ठिता ।
ब्रह्मलोकादपक्रान्ता सप्तधा प्रतिपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: "There the goddess who flows by three paths first took her stand; descending from the world of Brahma she divides into seven streams."

verses.text:
वस्वोकसारा नलिनी पावना च सरस्वती ।
जम्बूनदी च सीता च गङ्गा सिन्धुश्च सप्तमी ॥

meaning.en: "They are Vasvokasara, Nalini, Pavana, Sarasvati, Jambunadi, Sita, and Ganga, with Sindhu the seventh."

verses.text:
अचिन्त्या दिव्यसंकल्पा प्रभोरेषैव संविधिः ।
उपासते यत्र सत्रं सहस्रयुगपर्यये ॥

meaning.en: "This is the Lord's own arrangement, inconceivable and of divine design, where they keep a sacrificial session through a thousand ages."

verses.text:
दृश्यादृश्या च भवति तत्र तत्र सरस्वती ।
एता दिव्याः सप्त गङ्गास्त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुताः ॥

meaning.en: "Sarasvati is seen in some places and unseen in others; these seven divine Gangas are famed in the three worlds."

verses.text:
रक्षांसि वै हिमवति हेमकूटे तु गुह्यकाः ।
सर्पा नागाश्च निषधे गोकर्णे च तपोधनाः ॥

meaning.en: "Rakshasas live on the Himalaya, Guhyakas on Hemakuta, serpents and Nagas on Nishadha, and ascetics at Gokarna."

verses.text:
देवासुराणां च गृहं श्वेतः पर्वत उच्यते ।
गन्धर्वा निषधे शैले नीले ब्रह्मर्षयो नृप ।
शृङ्गवांस्तु महाराज पितॄणां प्रतिसंचरः ॥

meaning.en: "Shveta mountain is called the home of the gods and Asuras; the Gandharvas live on Nishadha, the Brahmin sages on Nila, King, and Shringavan, great king, is the resort of the ancestors."

verses.text:
इत्येतानि महाराज सप्त वर्षाणि भागशः ।
भूतान्युपनिविष्टानि गतिमन्ति ध्रुवाणि च ॥

meaning.en: "These, great king, are the seven regions, in which beings, mobile and fixed, dwell by their portions."

verses.text:
तेषामृद्धिर्बहुविधा दृश्यते दैवमानुषी ।
अशक्या परिसंख्यातुं श्रद्धेया तु बुभूषता ॥

meaning.en: "Their prosperity, both divine and human, is of many kinds and is seen; it cannot be counted, but should be believed by one who wishes to prosper."

verses.text:
यां तु पृच्छसि मा राजन्दिव्यामेतां शशाकृतिम् ।
पार्श्वे शशस्य द्वे वर्षे उभये दक्षिणोत्तरे ।
कर्णौ तु नागद्वीपं च कश्यपद्वीपमेव च ॥

meaning.en: "As for the divine hare-form you ask about, King, the two regions, southern and northern, are the sides of the hare; its ears are Nagadvipa and Kashyapadvipa."

verses.text:
ताम्रवर्णः शिरो राजञ्श्रीमान्मलयपर्वतः ।
एतद्द्वितीयं द्वीपस्य दृश्यते शशसंस्थितम् ॥

meaning.en: "Its head, King, is the splendid Malaya mountain, coppery in colour. This is the second view of the island, seen as the hare."
